newsitem.title: HONG KONG: IDT offers 22 mln shrs in Singapore unit.
newsitem.headline: IDT offers 22 mln shrs in Singapore unit.

text.p: IDT International Ltd said it will offer 22.08 million shares in IDT Holdings (Singapore) Ltd at US$0.73 per share (HK$5.64) in a separate primary listing of the subsidiary in Singapore.

IDT International said in an announcement issued late Tuesday that the company would offer 11.04 million existing shares currently held by IDT (BVI) and 11.04 million new shares to the public. The shares would represent 25 percent of the enlarged issued capital of the subsidiary.
The shares are offered on a price/earnings ratio of 8.3 times March 1997 earnings. This is based on forecast earnings of HK$54 million and a weighted average issued capital of 79.11 million shares.
IDT Holdings (Singapore)is forecast to achieve turnover of HK$469 million and profit before tax of HK$60 million.
For the six months ended September 30, 1996, IDT Holdings (Singapore) reported profit after tax and minority interests of HK$37.92 million.
IDT International has given an undertaking to the Stock Exchange of Singapore not to reduce their aggregate shareholding to below 50.1 percent for a period of one year from the listing date.
Dealings in IDT Holdings (Singapore) Ltd shares on the Singapore stock exchange are expected to commence on January 27.
The lead manager of the offer is Vickers Ballas Singapore.
